name: Interval Volume Decomposer
aliases: Level-Set Graph Traversal for IV Decomposition Order
definition: An interface and algorithm that decomposes an entire volume into feature subvolumes (interval volumes) by tracking the topological transitions of isosurfaces with respect to the scalar field, constructing a level-set graph, and enabling systematic decomposition from outside to inside.
summary: The Interval Volume Decomposer is an algorithm that decomposes scalar volumes into feature subvolumes by constructing a level-set graph to systematically traverse topological transitions from exterior to interior.
